name: herdr-mcp
description: Monitor and control AI coding agents running in Herdr terminal workspaces

HERDR_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.title: Enable write operations
HERDR_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE.description: Set to '1' to enable write tools (tab create, agent start, prompt, send-keys, rename, close). Leave empty for read-only mode.

HERDR_MCP_MACHINE.title: Remote machine
HERDR_MCP_MACHINE.description: Optional: Target a remote herdr server via saved SSH machine label or ID.
